content: The Founder picks up the lid card and turns it over twice. 'I like that the number is on the front. If the guide is part of the object, I can live with it. It's not a leaflet if it's numbered.' He hands it to Brand, the closest thing to agreement he's given all morning.
round_time: Just before lunch, Day 1 - PP1 continued

content: Head of Product writes it up. 'Provisional PP1 bundle. Prevent: lid card and fixed seed storage. Know: the germination test, plus the bloom-or-not follow-up with real buyers. Remedy: CX's dead-seed flow. Spare seeds are parked until Finance has the cost. The decision stays open until Legal and Finance have looked at the remedy wording.'
round_time: Just before lunch, Day 1 - PP1 continued

decisions.text: PP1 bundle provisionally adopted: lid growing card (Designer + Plant), seed storage fix (Ops), germination test (Plant), bloom-or-not follow-up (Research + CX), dead-seed replacement flow (CX); spare seeds parked pending Finance

content: Research holds up a hand when Growth starts drafting a caption. 'One condition on the time-lapse. If the test goes badly, we publish that too, or we don't film it. Selective proof is just a nicer way of making up a number.'
round_time: Just before lunch, Day 1 - PP1 continued
disagreement: Research vs Growth: publish the germination test whatever the result, or don't film it

content: Brand runs a thumbnail along the card edge. 'Fine, but I write the words. Plain language, no exclamation marks, no cartoon sun. It should read like a note from the person who painted the tin.' The Designer raises an eyebrow: it has to fit four steps a stressed gift buyer can actually follow.
round_time: Just before lunch, Day 1 - PP1 continued
disagreement: Brand (voice and look of the card) vs Designer (function and legibility first)

content: The Designer slides the card back. 'Your words, my hierarchy. Steps are numbered, the font's big enough to read on a balcony, and the line about what to do if nothing comes up stays on the card. That last line is the whole point.'
round_time: Just before lunch, Day 1 - PP1 continued

content: The Plant Specialist sits next to Finance. 'On spare seeds: a second sowing chance in the box could stop some failures from ever reaching CX. I can't tell you how many, because we don't know the germination rate. That's why the test comes first.'
round_time: Just before lunch, Day 1 - PP1 continued

proposals.text: Spare seeds in the box as a second sowing chance (parked until germination test and costs are known)
proposals.cost: per-unit cost UNKNOWN; Finance to compare against replacement cost
proposals.test: compare claim rate with vs without spares once data exists

content: Growth exhales through their nose but gives in. 'Fine. Honest time-lapse whatever happens. If it's ugly, we caption it as the reason the card exists.'
round_time: Just before lunch, Day 1 - PP1 continued

content: Community offers to share the load. 'I'll send the bloom-or-not messages with you. People who reply with a bloom, I'll ask if we can share it. People who reply with a dead pot get your remedy first, and no ask from me.'
round_time: Just before lunch, Day 1 - PP1 continued

content: CX nods hard. 'Agreed. And I want the remedy line printed on the card itself: if nothing comes up by a given day, tell us and we'll make it right. The exact promise belongs to item 2, so the card waits on that wording.'
round_time: Just before lunch, Day 1 - PP1 continued

content: Ops moves the seed packets off the sunny windowsill into a cardboard box on the shelf, writes today's date on it and adds a line to their notebook: storage conditions, record from now on. Small, and finally something they can control.
round_time: Just before lunch, Day 1 - PP1 continued

content: Finance turns the notebook round so everyone can see. 'Replacement exposure = claims x (seed packet + packing + postage). I have none of those three numbers. I'll put a ceiling instead: if every one of 100 buyers claimed, the ceiling is 100 x that per-claim cost. It'll be small against Rs 1,09,900, a few percent at most I'd guess. But that's a guess, so it's labelled one until Ops gives me quotes.'
round_time: Just before lunch, Day 1 - PP1 continued

proposals.text: Finance models replacement exposure as claims x (seed + packing + postage) once Ops supplies quotes; worst-case ceiling = 100 claims
proposals.test: compare modelled vs actual claims after Archive 002

content: Legal: 'Printing a remedy on the card makes it a commitment. Good, if we keep it. Keep it to what CX can actually deliver, with a clear time window. Verify with a professional.'
round_time: Just before lunch, Day 1 - PP1 continued
